features.quote: Max tool calls per run: 200 (hard ceiling to bound cost).
If S3 is detected and sustained for 12 tool calls, the harness auto-kills to cap cost.
Hard token ceiling per run (e.g., 500k tokens). Auto-kill at 90% of ceiling.
The judge is a stateful pipeline operating in real time on the AUT action stream.
Battery operates in an air-gapped sandbox. No external API calls. The intent is to induce *inefficiency*, not jailbreaks or harmful generation.
